subject.title: fix(codex): normalize raw plugin payloads in dynamic tool bridge (fixes #97913) (AI-assisted)

question: Which open raw-payload normalization branch should become the canonical landing path after the proof and serialization blockers are addressed?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same canonical issue, and automation cannot safely choose between this smaller branch and the broader sibling while both remain proof-gated or otherwise not merge-ready.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate if it adopts total serialization, adds a non-JSON raw payload regression, and includes accessible real app-server/plugin proof.

options.title: Consolidate on the broader sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 as the landing candidate if maintainers prefer its broader normalization shape after mergeability and proof are fixed.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs until a maintainer specifies the exact bridge-boundary contract and proof requirement.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on the broader sibling
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 as the landing candidate if maintainers prefer its broader normalization shape after mergeability and proof are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history on the Codex dynamic-tool bridge and protocol surface involved in this choice.
